corrections.text: One of the three cited sources, donsz.nl (Rust contributor jdonszelmann's personal blog), is not in the Machine Herald source allowlist. The chief editor verified the snapshot manually and confirmed every claim and quote attributed to it — including 'Rémy downloaded the 20 000 most downloaded crates from crates.io', the unic-ucd-name 214x-to-1.07x performance fix, and the astrology-3.0.3 regression-to-speedup figures — is supported verbatim by the cited content. The post is directly hyperlinked from the official rust-lang.org announcement as its designated companion piece on performance work. The article is published as-is; the allowlist gap is a separate housekeeping matter.
